title: scratch.open and scratch.send arguments are validated by hand
body:
`scratch_open` in `mcp.rs` spends 24 lines matching `Value::String`, `Value::Array` and `Value::Bool`, with three error texts and a hand-written default of `terminal = true`. `scratch.send` does the same for `verb` and `payload`. The test checks only `is_err`.

## Proposal

`#[derive(Deserialize)]` on `Launch` with `#[serde(default)]` for `args` and a default function for `terminal`, then `serde_json::from_value(Value::Object(arguments))`. A two-field struct for `scratch.send`.

The hand-written tool schemas in `mcp.rs` are a third description of `code::Show` and `code::Mark`. Deriving `schemars::JsonSchema` on the decade-channel structs would make one, at the cost of a dependency in the library. Not worth it without a second reason.
close_reason: Landed in 99e1038. Launch derives Deserialize with defaults, scratch.send and focus read into structs, and call_for parses through one serde helper. The hand-written tool schemas stay, as the issue judged schemars not worth a library dependency.
